findings.text: the report cites the guard at nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:3590, but line 3590 is the `@staticmethod` decorator; the `def current_normalisation_amplitude(...)` line it decorates is 3591. This is a one-line-off citation (decorator vs def) rather than a wrong function, and does not affect any of the report's substantive claims, which all check out against the actual method.

justifications.durability: the report, nan-inputs.json, both probe logs and the probe script are all committed and self-contained: a reader can re-run probe_low_state_amplitude_nan.py against the same reference part (sha256 pinned) to reproduce the same nan structure without depending on any run-directory scratch state, and the report explicitly separates what was measured (the nan structure, the guard inputs, the capacity value from a pre-existing committed receipt) from what was only logically inferred (that cut_count exceeds 342) versus not measured at all (cut_count's actual value).
justifications.evidence: I independently re-verified essentially every checkable claim in this report and all reproduced exactly: nine separate line-number citations in clip_quadrature.py and forward_operator.py (34, 352, 713, 733, 754, 816, 47, 2586, 3230/3517/3541), the dimension_context fields in the pre-existing hlo-large-buffers-300.json (cells=342, cut_cell_bank_capacity=342), the full nan-inputs.json structure (shape [3,342], nan=1026=3×342, target_current value, reference_part_sha256), and both job outcomes in the session's own stream.jsonl (job 1276152 dying on 'the discriminator requires one H200, got cpu:0' exactly as quoted, and job 1276161 running on 98dci4-gpu-0003 under betelgeuse/gpu_0003_grpA exactly as claimed). Only one citation (finding 1) was off, by one line, to a decorator rather than the def line.
justifications.fit: no plan/stage/sprint label appears in any commit message, filename or the report; the 'fix' commit is correctly scoped to the probe script's own monkeypatch target (ForwardFluxOperator vs ForwardOperatorBatch) rather than touching any nova/ production file, and the commit message explains precisely why the first patch attempt was wrong, which is the right level of detail for a fix that only affects instrumentation.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal (attribute which input to the current-normalisation guard is nan, and why) is answered with a complete causal chain from the guard's raise back through the exact producer function, the sentinel-return code path, the specific capacity constant and its committed value, down to the state (row, arm, mechanism) that triggers it — substantially deeper than a bare reproduction, while correctly declining to measure cut_count's exact value (out of budget) and correctly declining to run the negative control (the coordinator closed the node with no further jobs authorized), both stated as outstanding rather than silently skipped or fabricated.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff shows exactly 8 files changed, all under the declared docs/figures/figure-and-solver-audit/low-state-amplitude-nan/ directory, with zero touches to nova/ or tests/ (confirmed both by git diff and by the report's own repeated claim); the node correctly reported, rather than fixed, an unrelated NameError bug it found in a concurrent node's file (benchmarks/exact_clip_low_state_discriminator.py:405), attributing it to the owning node fsa-repair-low-state-level-array instead of reaching into it.
